tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Reprojects coordinates or WKT geometries from one Coordinate Reference System (CRS) to another using the `pyproj <https://pyproj4.github.io/pyproj/>`_ library.
Two modes are available depending on whether a WKT column is provided:
- **Lat/Lon mode** *(default)* — reads plain latitude and longitude columns and writes two new columns with the reprojected X/Y values. - **WKT mode** — reads a column of WKT geometries (e.g. ``POINT``, ``LINESTRING``, ``POLYGON``) and writes a new column with the reprojected geometries in WKT format.
-----
**Inputs**
+---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+ | Parameter | Required | Description | +=====================+==========+==========================================================+ | Input CRS | Yes | CRS of the source data, chosen from the list of | | | | supported EPSG codes (e.g. ``EPSG:4326`` for WGS 84). | +---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+ | Output CRS | Yes | Target CRS, chosen from the list of supported EPSG | | | | codes (e.g. ``EPSG:3857`` for Web Mercator). | +---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+ | Input CSV | Yes | CSV file containing the coordinates to transform. | +---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+ | Latitude Column | Yes | Name of the column holding latitude values. Letters, | | | | digits and underscores only. | +---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+ | Longitude Column | Yes | Name of the column holding longitude values. Letters, | | | | digits and underscores only. | +---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+ | WKT Geometry Column | No | Name of the column holding WKT geometries. When set, | | | | lat/lon columns are ignored and geometry reprojection | | | | is performed instead. Letters, digits and underscores | | | | only. | +---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+
-----
**Output**
A CSV file containing all original columns plus:
- **Lat/Lon mode**: two added columns named ``<lon_col>_<output_crs>`` and ``<lat_col>_<output_crs>``. The original coordinate columns are renamed to ``<col>_<input_crs>`` for traceability. - **WKT mode**: one added column named ``<wkt_col>_<output_crs>`` containing the reprojected WKT geometries.
-----
**Examples**
*Lat/Lon mode* — reproject WGS 84 coordinates to Web Mercator::
Input CRS: EPSG:4326 Output CRS: EPSG:3857 Latitude Column: latitude Longitude Column: longitude
*WKT mode* — reproject WGS 84 linestrings to Web Mercator::
Input CRS: EPSG:4326 Output CRS: EPSG:3857 WKT Geometry Column: wkt
-----
**Supported EPSG codes**
Input CRS and Output CRS are chosen from a curated list of 300 EPSG codes (verified against the official PROJ/EPSG geodetic database), grouped by region: worldwide reference frames, world-scale projected systems, the full global UTM grid (WGS 84, NAD83, ETRS89, SIRGAS 2000), and national/regional systems for Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Asia, Oceania, and the Americas. Defaults are ``EPSG:4326`` (WGS 84, GPS latitude/longitude) for Input CRS and ``EPSG:3857`` (Web Mercator) for Output CRS. See ``macros.xml`` for the full list, organised by section comments.
